_comment: Spawn-point catalog (real data drives the schema). Each spawn is monster-lair behavior the engine triggers when the party steps on (or near) a map cell whose tile carries this spawn's id in its `spawn` field. The binding lives on the map cell, not here — multiple cells (and multiple maps) can reuse the same Spawn. `spawn_monsters` and `boss_monsters` are Monster `id` strings (snake_case); `loot` is Item `id` strings. Duplicate entries in any of these are intentional — they control sampling weight (one Goblin five times = five times more likely). Optional `custom_map` is a Map `id` — when set, stepping into this lair's boss fight uses that authored battle map instead of the default arena.

spawns.name: Campfire Spawn
spawns.description: A smoldering campfire attracts wandering creatures.
